# Making *complex data* legible to anyone in the room.


::: {.hero-sub}
I'm Max Avramis — a recent Master of Public Policy graduate from UC San Diego's School of Global Policy and Strategy, specializing in American and Comparative Business Regulation and Program Design and Evaluation. 

I use multi-criteria decision analysis, program evaluation, GIS, and machine learning to turn messy, multi-source data into decisions people can trust, for the leaders shaping the policies and programs around us.

Open to full-time roles and consulting engagements.
